summary: TOOL-4 Filter products by category and brand
description:
As a customer, I want to filter so I can narrow down the catalogue.

* Selecting one category → only products from that category appear.
* Selecting two categories → products from both appear.
* Combining a category and a brand → only products matching both appear.
* Unchecking all filters → the full list returns.

criteria.text: Selecting one category → only products from that category appear.
Selecting two categories → products from both appear.
Combining a category and a brand → only products matching both appear.
Unchecking all filters → the full list returns.

cases.title: Filtering by a single category shows only that category's products
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue is open with no filters applied. <a category that contains at least one product> exists, and at least one product outside that category exists.
steps: Open the product catalogue with no filters selected.
Select the category filter <a category that contains at least one product>.
cases.expected: Only products from the selected category appear in the list; products from other categories are no longer shown.

cases.title: Filtering by two categories shows products from both
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue is open with no filters applied. <two categories that each contain at least one product> exist.
steps: Open the product catalogue with no filters selected.
Select the first category filter <category A>.
Select the second category filter <category B> in addition to the first.
cases.expected: Products from both selected categories appear in the list.

cases.title: Combining a category and a brand shows only products matching both
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue is open with no filters applied. <a category and a brand that together have at least one matching product> exist, and the category also contains products of other brands.
steps: Open the product catalogue with no filters selected.
Select the category filter <the chosen category>.
Select the brand filter <the chosen brand>.
cases.expected: Only products that belong to the selected category and are of the selected brand appear; products matching only one of the two filters are not shown.

cases.title: Unchecking all filters returns the full list
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue is open with no filters applied. <a category and a brand that each have at least one product> exist.
steps: Open the product catalogue with no filters selected and note the full list of products.
Select the category filter <the chosen category>.
Select the brand filter <the chosen brand>.
Uncheck the category filter so that no filters remain selected.
cases.expected: The full product list returns, matching the unfiltered list noted in step 1.

cases.title: Category and brand combination with no matching products
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue is open with no filters applied. <a category and a brand that have no products in common> exist.
steps: Open the product catalogue with no filters selected.
Select the category filter <the chosen category>.
Select the brand filter <the brand that has no products in that category>.
cases.expected: No products are shown, because only products matching both filters appear. (Exact empty-result message or display not specified in the story.)
